## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Compile validated ordered assignments while preserving unrelated resource behavior.

**Scope:** Generic changed-animation writer, ACT layers/timing/events/anchors and targeted replacement boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Compile validated images and ordered ACT layers without flattening, retaining supported raw metadata/opaque fields and rejecting unsupported lossless modifications.
- [x] Bounded Novice action replacement preserves unrelated numeric ACT slots and head resources; classic retained art remains explicitly outside new-art completeness.
- [x] Retain transformed multilayer positions, tint/alpha, events, delays and anchors; meaningful layer order survives serialization.
- [x] Source resources remain immutable and compatibility/output policy is explicit.
